points.description: States that firm yield is the maximum (or highest) amount of water/supply that can be supplied or guaranteed/reliably delivered.
points.partial_credit: Half marks if only says it is the amount of supply/yield from a source without 'maximum' or reliability/guarantee idea.

points.description: States that this is during the critical dry period (drought / lowest-flow period / worst dry spell).
points.partial_credit: Half marks if only vaguely refers to dry or low-flow conditions or a long period.

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying firm yield is the maximum supply that can be reliably guaranteed during the worst dry/drought period, in any wording. Give part marks if only one of the two ideas (maximum guaranteed supply; critical dry period) is clear or both are vague. Give no marks for wrong definitions, such as average yield or flood flow.
